description: This file defines an API client for a React frontend application, utilizing axios for HTTP requests. It includes functions for authentication, user management, session tracking, deployment management, and utility functions for URL handling and localStorage persistence.

methods.name: inferBackendBase
methods.description: Infers the backend base URL based on environment variables and window location, avoiding mixed content issues.

methods.name: joinUrl
methods.description: Concatenates base URL and path, ensuring proper slashes.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the authentication token from localStorage.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Stores or removes the authentication token in localStorage.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Stores or removes the user profile in localStorage.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the user profile from localStorage.

methods.name: normalizeListResponse
methods.description: Normalizes API list responses to extract items, total count, and metadata.
